text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: EPS and average shares outstanding common reflect a 2-for-1 split.

1997 Q1 net income includes one-time gain of $1.36 a share on the sale of Knight-Ridder's interest in all but one of the jointly owned cable investments it had made with Tele-Communications Inc.The pre-tax gain on the sale was $222 million. After taxes, the gain was $128 million.
Excluding the gain, Knight-Ridder earned $0.49 in the first quarter of 1997, up $0.25 or 104.2 percent from $0.24 in the same period last year.
On this same basis, the company reported net income of $46.4 million, up 97.3 percent from $23.5 million last year, and operating income of $97.5 million, up 92.6 percent from $50.6 million in 1996.
First Call Q1 consensus estimate was $0.47
Full company name is Knight-Ridder Inc.
